name: Tiro
description: A Theran human bound to Kynaios by love for him and for freedom, who helped defeat Agnomakhos and guards Meletis.

description_citations.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
description_citations.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise together to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and rally the people.
timeline.quote: Kynaios and Tiro, joined by their love for one another and for freedom, rose to challenge him.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
timeline.quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment
